findings: Pin::new_unchecked receives an owned non-Deref PendingFreeBatch and cannot compile.
Circular-empty detach points the destination at source and then nulls source, leaving invalid or dangling links.
The additive-only packet prematurely replaces production finish behavior, adds an arbitrary 4096-node rejection and changes reset/callback ordering.
Four grep checks are not executable M03-B vectors.
The intended private unsafe ownership boundary is public and incompletely documented.

positive_observations: Nonempty transfer repairs both boundary links and preserves page metadata.
Validation precedes nonempty mutation and release.
PhantomPinned plus raw-pointer PhantomData supplies the intended negative auto-traits and no freeing destructor was added.
required_correction: Restore production mem_finish_free_pages_pending_result byte-for-byte and keep the first primitive additive/private.
Pin a final-address local by reference and explicitly handle circular-empty detach.
Add actual focused Rust/C-reference vectors including later-invalid atomic rejection and compile-fail trait checks before any integration.
